# SPECIFICATION: REWARDS EARNING RULES DISPLAY

## CURRENT STATE SUMMARY:

Today, reward points are earned automatically at presentment based on pre-configured rules (accelerated, standard, or exclusion) but customers cannot see why they received a specific cashback rate. Operations teams manually handle queries about earning discrepancies using the SOP document. Customer support references backend configurations to explain earning logic when customers raise tickets.

---

## SCOPE:

### IN SCOPE:
- Display earning rule applied to each transaction in transaction detail view
- Show earning rate percentage or multiplier for completed transactions
- Display merchant category classification that determined the earning rule
- Show accelerated rewards cap status when applicable
- Display exclusion reason when zero rewards earned on eligible transaction types
- Provide earning rule explanation in rewards summary section

### OUT OF SCOPE:
- Predictive earning estimates before transaction completion — requires real-time MID/TID matching not available pre-authorization
- Editing or disputing earning rules through the app — requires ops workflow and approval process outside current scope
- Historical recalculation of earnings for past statement cycles — impacts accounting reconciliation and provisioning already completed
- Gamification or earning rate comparison with other cards — requires competitive intelligence data not currently maintained
- Custom earning rule creation by users — violates product configuration and risk management policies

---

## FUNCTIONAL USE CASES:

### Use Case 1: View earning rule for standard transaction
**Actor:** Primary cardholder  
**Precondition:** User has completed transaction that earned reward points, transaction status is "presentment completed"

**User Story:** As a Pixel cardholder, I want to see why I earned 1% cashback on my grocery purchase so that I understand my rewards accumulation and can optimize future spending.

**Steps:**
1. User navigates to transaction history on home screen
2. User taps on specific completed transaction showing reward points earned
3. System displays transaction detail screen with earning rule section
4. System shows "Standard Earning: 1% cashback" with merchant category "Grocery Stores (MCC 5411)"
5. User views total points earned calculation: ₹500 transaction × 1% = 5 reward points

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given transaction has presentment status and earned rewards, when user opens transaction detail, then earning rule section displays above transaction amount breakdown
- Given transaction earned standard rate, when earning rule loads, then system shows "Standard Earning: [X]% cashback" with merchant category name and MCC code
- Given transaction amount and earning rate, when calculation displays, then formula shows "₹[amount] × [rate]% = [points] reward points" with correct arithmetic
- Given merchant category determined earning rule, when category displays, then merchant name from transaction matches category classification shown
- Given user views earning rule, when section renders, then information displays within 200ms of transaction detail load

**Failure State AC:**
- Given earning rule data unavailable from backend, when transaction detail loads, then user sees "Earning details temporarily unavailable" with retry option
- Given transaction still in authorization status, when user opens detail, then earning rule section shows "Rewards will be calculated at settlement" message
- Given system timeout retrieving earning configuration, when detail loads after 5 seconds, then user sees "Unable to load earning details" with support contact option

**Priority:** P0

---

### Use Case 2: View accelerated earning with cap status
**Actor:** Primary cardholder  
**Precondition:** User completed transaction at accelerated merchant, accelerated cap threshold exists for current period

**User Story:** As a Pixel cardholder, I want to see that I earned 5X rewards on my e-commerce purchase and how much accelerated earning I have remaining so that I can maximize high-value rewards before hitting the cap.

**Steps:**
1. User opens transaction detail for e-commerce purchase at accelerated merchant
2. System retrieves earning rule showing accelerated category match
3. System calculates remaining accelerated cap: monthly cap ₹10,000 minus ₹7,500 already used = ₹2,500 remaining
4. System displays "Accelerated Earning: 5X rewards (5%)" with merchant name and "₹2,500 remaining in accelerated earning this month"
5. User taps "View accelerated merchants" link to see full list of eligible merchants

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given transaction at accelerated merchant below cap, when earning rule displays, then system shows "Accelerated Earning: [X]X rewards ([Y]%)" with highlighted badge
- Given accelerated cap exists for period, when earning rule loads, then system shows "₹[amount] remaining in accelerated earning this [period]" below earning rate
- Given user has exceeded accelerated cap, when transaction at accelerated merchant displays, then system shows "Standard Earning: 1% cashback" with note "Accelerated cap reached for this month"
- Given accelerated earning applied, when user taps merchant name, then system shows "This merchant qualifies for accelerated rewards" tooltip
- Given multiple accelerated categories exist, when user taps "View accelerated merchants" link, then system navigates to full accelerated merchant list screen

**Failure State AC:**
- Given accelerated cap calculation fails, when earning rule loads, then system shows earning rate without cap status and logs error for ops review
- Given cap period boundary condition (last day of month), when transaction processes, then system uses correct period for cap calculation or shows "Cap status updating"

**Priority:** P0

---

### Use Case 3: View exclusion reason for zero rewards
**Actor:** Primary cardholder  
**Precondition:** User completed transaction at excluded merchant category, transaction shows ₹0 rewards earned

**User Story:** As a Pixel cardholder, I want to understand why I earned zero rewards on my fuel purchase so that I know which transaction types don't earn rewards and can plan accordingly.

**Steps:**
1. User notices ₹0 rewards on fuel station transaction in transaction list
2. User taps transaction to view detail screen
3. System identifies merchant MCC in exclusion list (MCC 5541 - Service Stations)
4. System displays "No Rewards Earned" section with reason "Fuel purchases are excluded from rewards earning per program terms"
5. User taps "View excluded categories" link to see complete exclusion list

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given transaction at excluded merchant, when earning rule section loads, then system displays "No Rewards Earned" header in neutral color (not error red)
- Given exclusion reason exists in configuration, when section renders, then system shows specific reason text: "[Category] purchases are excluded from rewards earning per program terms"
- Given merchant MCC in exclusion list, when user views detail, then merchant category name displays with MCC code for transparency
- Given exclusion list exists, when user taps "View excluded categories" link, then system navigates to full exclusion list screen with categories like "Fuel (MCC 5541)", "Wallet Loading (MCC 6540)"
- Given transaction excluded but non-zero amount, when detail displays, then system confirms transaction amount processed correctly, only rewards excluded

**Failure State AC:**
- Given exclusion configuration unavailable, when transaction detail loads, then system shows "Rewards calculation pending" rather than incorrect earning amount
- Given merchant MCC not found in any configuration list, when earning rule loads, then system shows "Standard Earning: 1% cashback" as default and logs MCC for ops review

**Priority:** P1

---

## NON-FUNCTIONAL USE CASES:

- **Performance - Earning Rule Retrieval Latency**: Earning rule data must load within 200ms of transaction detail screen render for 95th percentile requests  
  **Acceptance:** Load testing shows p95 latency ≤200ms with 1000 concurrent users accessing transaction details; APM monitoring confirms metric in production

- **Performance - Accelerated Cap Calculation**: Cap remaining calculation must complete within 100ms to avoid blocking transaction detail display  
  **Acceptance:** Backend service returns cap status within 100ms for 99th percentile; timeout fallback shows earning rate without cap status after 500ms

- **Security - Earning Configuration Access**: Earning rule configurations (MCC mappings, accelerated merchant lists, caps) must not be exposed in client-side code or API responses beyond user's own transaction context  
  **Acceptance:** Security audit confirms no earning configuration endpoints accessible without transaction_id parameter; rate limiting prevents enumeration attacks

- **Accessibility - Screen Reader Support**: Earning rule information must be readable by screen readers with proper semantic HTML and ARIA labels  
  **Acceptance:** WCAG 2.1 AA compliance verified; screen reader testing confirms earning rate, merchant category, and cap status announced in logical order

- **Reliability - Graceful Degradation**: If earning rule service unavailable, transaction detail must still display with earning amount shown but explanation unavailable  
  **Acceptance:** Circuit breaker opens after 3 consecutive failures; transaction detail renders with "Earning details temporarily unavailable" message; 99.9% uptime SLA maintained

- **Data Consistency - Earning Rule Version Control**: Earning rule displayed must match the configuration version active at transaction presentment timestamp  
  **Acceptance:** Each transaction record stores earning_rule_version_id; display logic retrieves historical configuration if current version differs; reconciliation report shows zero discrepancies

---

## METRICS IMPACT:

- **Metric name:** Rewards-related support ticket volume  
  **Current baseline:** Unknown — check with customer support analytics team for baseline ticket count tagged "rewards inquiry" or "cashback question"  
  **Expected impact:** 30-40% reduction in rewards explanation tickets within 60 days of launch as users self-serve earning rule information  
  **Owner:** Customer Support Operations team

- **Metric name:** Transaction detail screen engagement rate  
  **Current baseline:** Unknown — check with product analytics for current percentage of users who tap transactions from list view  
  **Expected impact:** 15-25% increase in transaction detail views as users explore earning explanations; average time on screen increases 8-12 seconds  
  **Owner:** Product Analytics team

- **Metric name:** Accelerated merchant transaction frequency  
  **Current baseline:** Unknown — check with business analytics for current monthly transaction count at accelerated MCCs  
  **Expected impact:** 10-15% increase in accelerated merchant usage as users discover and optimize for 5X earning opportunities through transparency  
  **Owner:** Business Analytics and Growth team

---

## NEW METRICS TO TRACK:

- **Metric name:** Earning rule display load success rate  
  **Definition:** Percentage of transaction detail views where earning rule section successfully renders with complete data (earning rate + merchant category + cap status if applicable) within 500ms  
  **Target:** ≥99.5% success rate across all transaction detail views  
  **Owner:** Engineering - Backend Services team

- **Metric name:** Accelerated cap awareness rate  
  **Definition:** Percentage of users with accelerated transactions who view transaction detail showing cap status at least once per statement cycle  
  **Target:** ≥60% of users with accelerated earnings view cap status monthly  
  **Owner:** Product Analytics team

- **Metric name:** Exclusion category discovery rate  
  **Definition:** Percentage of users with excluded transactions (zero rewards) who tap "View excluded categories" link within 30 days of first excluded transaction  
  **Target:** ≥40% of users with excluded transactions access full exclusion list  
  **Owner:** Product Analytics team

- **Metric name:** Earning rule data staleness  
  **Definition:** Time delta between transaction presentment timestamp and earning rule configuration version used for display; measures if historical configuration correctly retrieved  
  **Target:** 100% of transactions display earning rule from configuration version active at presentment time (zero version mismatches)  
  **Owner:** Engineering - Data Platform team

---

## REPORTS & EXTRACTS IMPACT:

**New reports needed:**
- Earning Rule Display Performance Report: Daily report showing earning rule load latency p50/p95/p99, success rate, failure reasons, broken down by transaction type (standard/accelerated/excluded)
- Accelerated Cap Utilization Report: Weekly report showing distribution of users by cap utilization percentage (0-25%, 25-50%, 50-75%, 75-100%, exceeded), average cap exhaustion day of month
- Exclusion Category Awareness Report: Monthly report showing excluded transaction volume by MCC, percentage of users viewing exclusion list, correlation with support ticket reduction

**Existing reports affected:**
- Transaction Detail Analytics Report: Add earning rule display metrics (load time, success rate, user interaction with earning section)
- Customer Support Ticket Classification Report: Add new ticket sub-category "Earning Rule - Display Issue" separate from "Earning Rule - Calculation Dispute"
- Rewards Reconciliation Report: Add earning_rule_version_id column to validate displayed rules match provisioning calculations

**Reconciliation requirements:**
- Daily reconciliation: Earning rule version displayed in app must match earning_rule_version_id stored in transaction record for 100% of transactions
- Monthly reconciliation: Sum of accelerated earnings shown to users must equal accelerated earnings in rewards provisioning report within ₹10 tolerance per account
- Weekly reconciliation: Excluded transaction count (zero rewards) in app analytics must match excluded transaction count in rewards accrual report with <0.1% variance

**Data extract requirements:**
- Customer Support team: Daily extract of transactions where earning rule display failed (for proactive outreach if user contacts support)
- Business Analytics team: Weekly extract of accelerated merchant transaction volume and cap hit rate (for merchant partnership ROI analysis)
- Finance team: Monthly extract of earning rule version history per transaction (for audit trail and regulatory compliance)
- Product team: Real-time stream of earning rule interaction events (taps on merchant category, view excluded list, view accelerated merchants) for funnel analysis

---

## INSTRUMENTATION REQUIREMENTS:

- **Event name:** `zcrw_earning_rule_viewed`  
  **Trigger:** When transaction detail screen loads and earning rule section successfully renders with complete data  
  **Properties:** `transaction_id` (string), `earning_type` (string: "standard"/"accelerated"/"excluded"), `earning_rate_percent` (float), `merchant_mcc` (string), `cap_status` (string: "below_cap"/"cap_reached"/"no_cap"/"cap_unavailable"), `load_time_ms` (integer), `rule_version_id` (string)  
  **Purpose:** Measure earning rule display success rate, identify performance bottlenecks, analyze which earning types users view most frequently

- **Event name:** `zcrw_earning_rule_interaction`  
  **Trigger:** When user taps interactive elements within earning rule section (merchant category name, "View accelerated merchants" link, "View excluded categories" link)  
  **Properties:** `transaction_id` (string), `interaction_type` (string: "tap_merchant_category"/"tap_view_accelerated"/"tap_view_excluded"), `earning_type` (string: "standard"/"accelerated"/"excluded"), `user_segment` (string: "new_user"/"active_user"/"power_user")  
  **Purpose:** Measure user engagement with earning explanations, identify which links drive discovery of accelerated/excluded merchants, inform content optimization

- **Event name:** `zcrw_earning_rule_load_failure`  
  **Trigger:** When earning rule section fails to load within 5 seconds or backend service returns error  
  **Properties:** `transaction_id` (string), `error_code` (string), `error_message` (string), `failure_reason` (string: "timeout"/"service_unavailable"/"data_missing"/"version_mismatch"), `retry_attempted` (boolean)  
  **Purpose:** Alert engineering to earning rule service degradation, identify data quality issues, measure impact of failures on user experience

- **Event name:** `zcrw_accelerated_cap_status_viewed`  
  **Trigger:** When user views transaction detail showing accelerated earning with cap remaining amount displayed  
  **Properties:** `transaction_id` (string), `cap_remaining_amount` (float), `cap_total_amount` (float), `cap_utilization_percent` (integer), `days_remaining_in_period` (integer), `user_id` (string)  
  **Purpose:** Analyze cap awareness timing (early vs late in cycle), identify users approaching cap for targeted communication, measure cap feature effectiveness

- **Event name:** `zcrw_excluded_category_discovered`  
  **Trigger:** When user views transaction detail for first excluded transaction (zero rewards) in their account lifetime  
  **Properties:** `transaction_id` (string), `merchant_mcc` (string), `excluded_category_name` (string), `transaction_amount` (float), `days_since_account_opening` (integer), `user_id` (string)  
  **Purpose:** Measure time-to-discovery of exclusions, identify most common first-excluded categories, inform onboarding content about exclusions to set expectations

---

## SUMMARY:

- External research shows users actively track and optimize rewards across cards using spreadsheets and community forums
- Transparent earning rules reduce support burden and increase accelerated merchant usage through informed spending decisions
- High confidence in support ticket reduction; moderate confidence in transaction frequency lift pending baseline data availability
